verdict.rationale: Rippling exposes a REST API with tokens, pagination, and full endpoint search/filter (docs-14/16/17/21/22/28), which could technically be used to extract data, but there is no explicit documentation of a full data-export feature, bulk export to open formats (CSV/JSON dumps), or any stated data-portability/offboarding guarantee for customers leaving the platform. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/full-account export tooling, stated open-format export (CSV/JSON), and documented data-portability/exit policy.
